coaching.title: Root-cause over symptom
coaching.weak: In 3/5 debug episodes the first failing symptom was patched without reproducing the cause.
coaching.why: Symptom patches regress; the bug returns next session and burns turns + trust.
coaching.how: Make it a personal reflex: your next debugs, reproduce first and say the cause in one sentence yourself before you touch anything — then fix the cause, not the stack-trace line.
coaching.example: Before your next fix, say to yourself: 'Root cause: pool connection shared across coroutines.' — then fix that.
coaching.retest_tip: Next scan, watch your own root_cause_depth — aim to feel yourself state a cause before the fix in every debug episode you run.

coaching.title: Verify through a different channel
coaching.weak: 2/6 completion claims were accepted because the agent said so, with no independent run.
coaching.why: The channel that made the claim can't also be the proof — that's how silent breakage ships.
coaching.how: Make it a personal rule: you don't accept 'done' until YOU have run or inspected the artifact through a different channel than the one that claimed it. Your next completions, prove it yourself before you believe it.
coaching.example: Next time an agent says 'it works', tell yourself: 'I'll believe it once I've run it and seen the result myself' — then do.
coaching.retest_tip: Next scan, watch your own verification — aim to feel the reflex to independently prove every 'done' before you accept it.

coaching.title: Persist decisions so mistakes don't repeat
coaching.weak: An env-var bug solved in session 2 recurred in session 5 because it was never written down.
coaching.why: Un-persisted knowledge is re-derived every session — you pay for the same lesson twice.
coaching.how: Make it a personal closing habit: after any non-trivial fix, take 30 seconds to write down — in your own words — the one lesson future-you will need, before you move on. Your next 5 fixes, end by leaving that note for yourself.
coaching.example: Before you move on, write yourself a line: 'Learned: a stale key was injected — check the env is clean before I trust the next run.'
coaching.retest_tip: Next scan, watch for any mistake you repeated across sessions — aim to feel yourself instinctively leave a note the moment you learn something the hard way.
